description: Add or remove ambient environment skins (skyboxes / weather / audio ambience) on the lot. guids_to_add and guids_to_clear are uint GUID arrays pointing into Content.Ambience.GetAmbienceFromGUID. Each list is server-capped at 40 entries. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side BuildBuyRoommate+). Effect: vm.Context.Ambience user-ambience set mutates accordingly; visible via client skybox/weather changes (not currently exposed to perception — no observable field). Cost: free. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetChangeEnvironmentCmd { GUIDsToAdd, GUIDsToClear }.
call_signatures: cf $CF change-environment --guids_to_add '[1234,5678]'                                                  # owner-only; up to 40 GUIDs
cf $CF change-environment --guids_to_add '[...]' --guids_to_clear '[...]'                               # both in one call
common_mistakes: Both guids_to_add and guids_to_clear empty → ok:false ('requires at least one').
Either array > 40 entries → ok:false (server-side hard cap).
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
